title: Relationships between metric views (Beta)
body: Relationships between Unity Catalog metric views are in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Use `ALTER VIEW ... ADD CONSTRAINT ... RELATIONSHIP` to record how a source metric view joins to a target metric view, including the cardinality and the join condition, so that AI assistants and BI tools choose the right join path. Relationships require Databricks Runtime 19 and above, or a SQL warehouse. See [Relationships between metric views](/aws/en/uc-semantics/metric-views/relationships).
